summary.text: Jackie Glass is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 93, which covers part of the City of Norfolk.
Jackie Glass has been a member since January 12, 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Jackie Glass was born in Chicago, Illinois.
Jackie Glass studied at Southern Illinois University Carbondale (B.S., Workforce Education Training and Development, 2014).
Jackie Glass's listed occupation is small business owner.
The profile says Jackie Glass served in the U.S. Navy from 2002 to 2013.

Jackie Glass's listed memberships and affiliations include the NAACP, the Ballentine Civic League (president), Reading Enriches All Children (board member), the Young Investors Group (board member), United State of Women (ambassador), the Community Emergency Response Team, and Mamas on the Block.
The profile lists Doran Douglas II as Jackie Glass's spouse.

The House profile lists Jackie Glass's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, Communications, Technology and Innovation, Transportation, and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, and Jackie Glass chairs the Election Administration subcommittee of Privileges and Elections, the Communications subcommittee of Communications, Technology and Innovation, and the Innovations (Ad Hoc) subcommittee of Transportation.
